description: Get the status, cost and output of one video job, including Higgsfield, HeyGen, camera, relight and ltx-2.5-alpha-gen jobs. When enable_caption=true on heygen-lipsync-v3 or heygen-translate, completed jobs expose a signed .srt subtitle download URL in output.caption_url; when enable_dynamic_duration=true, is_hold=true indicates the 1.25x hold is still settling to actual seconds.
name: get_video
